description: Searches and filters across all published Tresslers Group intelligence dossiers by keywords, strategic domain/category, tags, or conviction threshold.

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g., 'Geopolitics & Sovereign Policy', 'Energy & Infrastructure').

limit.description: Maximum number of dossiers to return (default: 5, max: 20).

query.description: Search query or keywords to match across title, excerpt, content, and tags.

name: search_dossiers

text.description: JSON representation of matching dossiers with scores, excerpts, and metadata.
